result.summary: No clear visual breakages are visible. The partially shown category and restaurant cards at the right edge and the cut-off card at the bottom appear to be intentional scrollable/viewport behavior.

issues.description: The search placeholder text and magnifying-glass icon are light gray on a very light gray search field, creating relatively low visual contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text and icon, or slightly darken the search-field background, to improve legibility and contrast.
